page.notes: Printed page 119, running head "Cap.3." read as "3" (the figure looks like ȝ) [?]. "Moguni pa.401" in the Erasmus note is uncertain [?]. "fa-vorem" is reconstructed from the split word, with u/v normalised [?]. The heading "I. AINMADVERSIO" is printed that way and left as is.
